text.id: "Demi adiknya." Kata yang sama. Pesan tengah malem itu nggak ditulis orang suruhan. Ditulis orang yang barusan nanya kabar kampus Dinda.
text.en: "For her sister's sake." The same words. That midnight message wasn't written by some hired thug. It was written by the man who just asked after Dinda's campus.

text.id: Satu menit dua belas detik. Suaranya sendiri.
text.en: One minute twelve seconds. In his own voice.

text.id: Kak Sekar pasti bangga. Itu kerjaan jurnalis.
text.en: Sekar would be proud. That's a journalist's work.

text.id: Semester lima. Dia tahu semester gue, Ka.
text.en: Fifth semester. He knows what semester I'm in, Ka.

text.id: Gue nggak bakal ke kampus minggu ini.
text.en: I'm not going to campus this week.

text.id: Dinda ngambil laptop Sekar dari meja dan mulai ngetik cepet, kayak orang yang butuh tangannya sibuk.
text.en: Dinda pulls Sekar's laptop off the desk and starts typing fast, like someone who needs her hands busy.

text.id: Kalau Kak Sekar takut HP-nya diambil, dia pasti backup. Dasbor podcast-nya bisa dibuka, berarti akun cloud-nya juga. Sandinya sama polanya.
text.en: If Sekar was scared of losing her phone, she'd have backed it up. Her podcast dashboard opened, so her cloud account will too. Same password pattern.

text.id: Sementara Dinda ngetik, gue inget satu kalimat lain dari kemarin siang. "Kalau ada yang menghubungi Anda soal HP itu, siapa pun, kabari saya dulu."
text.en: While Dinda types, I remember something else from yesterday afternoon. "If anyone contacts you about that phone, anyone at all, tell me first."
